concerns.text: Task T031 references a hysteresis controller but no preceding task implements the controller logic itself, leaving FR-004 (hysteresis controller) uncovered.

Load‑model validation results are saved only in `data/processed/model_metrics.json`; Constitution VI mandates that validation code and resulting metrics be committed under `code/validation/`. This violates the Load Model Validation principle.
No task computes or records checksums for raw data files, breaching Constitution III (Data Hygiene) which requires checksumming and recording under the project state.
Random seed pinning is absent from any task, violating Constitution I (Reproducibility) which requires seeds to be fixed in code.
Task T058 profiles training time but does not verify compliance with the GitHub Actions free‑tier limits (≤2 CPU cores, ≤7 GB RAM, ≤6 h wall‑clock). This leaves SC‑004 unaddressed.
There is no task that applies a multiple‑comparison / family‑wise‑error correction as required by FR‑007, so the correction step is missing.
Task T004 checks for required interaction columns but does not explicitly verify the presence of timestamped response fields required by FR‑001.
